name: Orbit
description: A few small dots circle the pointer and nothing is drawn along the path behind it. The ring widens as the pointer picks up speed and eases back in as it slows, and it hangs a little behind the cursor while moving, as though the dots were being dragged along. At speed each dot can smear slightly along its own direction of travel. Clicking makes the ring scatter outward and spring back. The dots keep circling for a couple of seconds after the pointer stops, then fade out.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Dot count
parameters.description: How many dots circle the pointer

parameters.name: Orbit radius
parameters.description: Widest the ring of dots can get (px)

parameters.name: Speed growth
parameters.description: How much faster movement widens the ring, 0 to hold it at the full radius

parameters.name: Orbit rate
parameters.description: Turns per second the dots make around the pointer

parameters.name: Lag
parameters.description: How far behind the cursor the ring hangs while moving (seconds), 0 to keep it centred

parameters.name: Smear
parameters.description: How much each dot stretches along its direction of travel at speed, 0 to keep it round

parameters.name: Click push
parameters.description: How far a click throws the dots outward before they spring back (px), 0 to disable

parameters.name: Last colour
parameters.description: Colour the remaining dots shade toward
